purpose: Retrospectively reserved 2020–2025 evaluation of the fixed graph reversal against baseline; no new trading rule or post-test selection
warmup: 2019 daily returns with 2018-12-31 anchor price; no splice with the earlier adjusted-price vintage
calendar: Require exact common observed SPY calendar for every stock; no forward filling, intersection, asset substitution or return-driven truncation

data_review.action: Stop before evaluation if missing/nonpositive data, calendar mismatch, overlap return difference above 0.1 bp, or absolute adjusted return above 40%; investigate and document any amendment before strategy evaluation

topology_decision: Retain descriptors only: H0 strongly overlaps simple correlation and H1 is window-sensitive; no direction/threshold/overlay is justified by completed diagnostics. This decision is made before test data acquisition.
scenario_rule: 16 models x fees cases at 2% borrow (baseline plus three diffusion settings), four extra baseline/primary-graph borrow cases at 5 bps, and two matched-gross cases at 5 bps/2% borrow; retain all 22; no winner promotion
exposure_control: Scale both primary decision portfolios down to the smaller of their two gross exposures before the existing execution delay; no leverage-up or volatility matching
execution: Decision close t, execution close t+1, first new-position return close t+2; shift before test slicing; start flat at USD100000; liquidate at final observed close; do not reset annually

inference.estimand: 252 times arithmetic daily mean, not CAGR; zero-cash-rate no-trade benchmark for the first two means
inference.paired_resampling: Use the same bootstrap index matrix for baseline, graph and their paired difference; seed = seed + block_length
inference.family_method: Bonferroni: each of three two-sided intervals at 1 - 0.05/3; approximate joint coverage depends on validity of the marginal bootstrap intervals
inference.hac_role: Cross-check of the same three arithmetic means with pointwise and Bonferroni-adjusted normal intervals; never choose between estimators after results
inference.matched_gross: Report paired difference with pointwise 95% stationary-bootstrap block length10, seed+1000, and HAC10; secondary descriptive diagnostic, not an additional claim chosen after results
inference.limitations: Conditional on observed policies and survivor basket, with approximate weak-dependence/stationarity assumptions. No strategy refitting or price reconstruction within resamples; no retrospective correction for universe selection or all previous research decisions.

evidence_gate.positive_compound_return: primary graph CAGR > 0 at 5 bps/2% borrow
evidence_gate.positive_absolute_mean: block10 Bonferroni lower bound for graph net arithmetic mean > 0
evidence_gate.positive_incremental_mean: block10 Bonferroni lower bound for graph-minus-baseline arithmetic mean > 0
evidence_gate.matched_gross_robustness: block10 pointwise lower bound for matched graph-minus-baseline mean > 0
evidence_gate.decision: All four are necessary for limited positive evidence within this sample. Failure means the predefined evidence criterion is not met; passing still does not establish deployability, population alpha or a point-in-time strategy.

diagnostics: Report complete-period metrics, every calendar-year contribution without resetting positions, cost decomposition, turnover, exposures and rolling63-session realised beta; no year exclusions

topology_transfer.models: Apply frozen development-only means/scales/coefficients from Milestone4 without refitting
topology_transfer.comparisons: All feature-control Spearman correlations and descriptor R2, all alternate-window rank correlations and monthly diagram bounds; no return targets, trading overlay or inferential significance claims
topology_transfer.interactive: Monthly primary-window H1 landscapes and paired diagrams for all 2020–2025 months; fixed display scales, five visual layers

known_information: Development and validation prices, strategies and topology findings were already seen. Historical 2020–2025 market events are publicly known; the basket was selected retrospectively from survivors. Reserved refers to project workflow, not an externally blind prospective test.
after_release: The test becomes observed permanently. No revision of parameters, primary model, feature set, inference settings or outcome dates based on test results. Future hypothesis revisions need newly reserved evidence.
registration: Local hashed record only; not external preregistration
